strategy_roster.name: Quadratic Regression
strategy_roster.notes: Regression-based direction is approximated by the one-bar slope of SMA(20); the DSL has no regression primitive.

strategy_roster.name: Arrows & Curves
strategy_roster.notes: RSI reference translated with period 14 and documented/default thresholds; platform-specific oscillator variants are simplified.

strategy_roster.name: ABE BE CCI Engulfing
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is approximated by a z-score of typical price because the local DSL has no dedicated CCI function; documented period is preserved where available.

strategy_roster.name: IU 4 Bar UP
strategy_roster.notes: SuperTrend is approximated by an EMA plus/minus ATR envelope using documented/default period and multiplier; exact recursive SuperTrend state is unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Keltner Volume
strategy_roster.notes: Keltner channel translated as EMA +/- ATR envelope; exact platform channel state is unsupported.

strategy_roster.name: MALR Channel Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Breakout reference translated with prior-bar Donchian extremes to preserve next-bar execution and avoid current-bar self-reference.

strategy_roster.name: TMA
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average reference translated with inferred/default periods 21/200; unsupported shifts, recursive state, or execution rules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: ColorSchaff JJRSX Trend Cycle
strategy_roster.notes: Specialized oscillator is approximated by percent price ROC over the documented/default period because the exact indicator is not available in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Compass Line
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger trend/breakout translation using the documented/default band length and deviation.

strategy_roster.name: Triple Stochastic MTF
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic is approximated from the close position within the 14-bar high/low range because the DSL has no dedicated stochastic function.
